description: Triangulated compute index: training compute (40%, Epoch AI), hardware supply (40%, NVIDIA revenue + Huawei Ascend), and visible HPC (20%, TOP500 + corrections). Coverage gaps are explicitly documented in hidden_compute_band.

training_compute.source: Epoch AI notable models since 2023 — disclosed training compute only
training_compute.coverage_note: Understates China: frontier closed models (Qwen-max, Doubao, Hunyuan) do not disclose compute. Disclosed compute is a lower bound for China.

hardware_supply.source: Hardware supply proxy: NVIDIA geographic data center revenue + Huawei Ascend deployment adjustment. Measures the flow of AI compute hardware to each country rather than just disclosed training runs.
hardware_supply.confidence: Low — not officially confirmed by Huawei; based on industry analysis and public procurement data

visible_hpc.source: TOP500 + private cluster estimates (xAI, Meta, Microsoft)

training_compute.source: Epoch AI notable models since 2023 — disclosed training compute only
training_compute.coverage_note: Understates China: frontier closed models (Qwen-max, Doubao, Hunyuan) do not disclose compute. Disclosed compute is a lower bound for China.

hardware_supply.source: Hardware supply proxy: NVIDIA geographic data center revenue + Huawei Ascend deployment adjustment. Measures the flow of AI compute hardware to each country rather than just disclosed training runs.
hardware_supply.confidence: Low — not officially confirmed by Huawei; based on industry analysis and public procurement data

visible_hpc.source: TOP500 + China non-submission corrections (Tianhe-3, Sunway NG, etc.)

hidden_compute_band.description: Explicit uncertainty band for total (visible + estimated hidden) compute. Not used in the scored composite — shown separately in the UI as a coverage note.
hidden_compute_band.confidence: Low — expert synthesis, not primary data
hidden_compute_band.narrative: The scored composite (25%) is a lower bound based primarily on disclosed data. A more complete estimate, incorporating government announcements and analyst assessments of China's domestic AI chip deployment, suggests China's true share of combined US-China compute capacity is likely in the 25-40% range. The gap between the disclosed and estimated figures reflects systematic non-reporting rather than compute that doesn't exist.

epoch_ai.methodology: Sums training_compute_flop for models published on/after 2023-01-01 with known compute >= 1e+20 FLOPs. Country by 'Country (of organization)'. Models without compute estimates are excluded — this understates totals for both countries, more so for China where frontier closed models do not disclose compute.

top500.china_non_submission_note: China stopped submitting its major supercomputers to TOP500 starting in 2023. The November 2023 list showed only 40 Chinese systems at 205 PFlops total, but China's actual HPC capacity is known to be significantly larger based on government announcements. TOP500 alone is not a valid primary metric for China.
